scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-deck-ir && npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-theme-default && npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-theme-company && npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-compiler && npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-renderer-react && npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-renderer-pptx && npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-exporter-pdf && npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-qa-pptx
scripts.build:runtime: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-cli
scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-studio
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:visual: npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-deck-ir --silent && npm run build -w @livetoon/slide-theme-default --silent && npm run test:e2e -w @livetoon/slide-studio
scripts.qa: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
